MessageContent renders AI answer content through dangerouslySetInnerHTML using HTML produced by formatMessage. formatMessage interpolates the raw content into HTML (e.g. the bold replacement on line 263) without escaping characters such as <, >, &, or quotes, so any HTML or script markup in the answer is executed in the page. This is a cross-site scripting vulnerability; the previous implementation escaped the content by rendering it as React text.

Suggested fix (model-generated, not tested):
```suggestion
     <span
       className="whitespace-pre-wrap"
       dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: escapeHtml(formatMessage(content, citations)) }}
     />
```
